dish: Black (sweet) and white chai tow kway — house-steamed radish cake fried without lard
address: #01-28 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: A Newton fixture since 1971 and a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand stall: the owner has 50+ years at the wok and still steams the radish cake in-house rather than buying it factory-made, frying black and white versions (plus oyster omelette) with vegetable oil only — no pork or lard.

dish: Boneless Teochew braised duck with rice, kway chap-style noodles or congee
address: #01-13 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: A 40-year-old braised-duck stall whose boneless, herbal-braised duck — over rice, congee or noodles — earned back-to-back MICHELIN Bib Gourmand listings (2023–2025); one of five Newton stalls that made the 2025 Bib list, the most of any hawker centre.

dish: Teochew sliced-fish porridge and fish-head soup
address: #01-20 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: A 60-year-old Teochew fish-porridge stall now run by the second generation — fresh-sliced fish in a clean broth, as porridge or soup — MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2021–2023 and on Seth Lui's Newton best-of (Oct 2024 update).

dish: Wok-hei fried Hokkien prawn mee (bee hoon + yellow noodles in prawn stock, pork lard)
n: Newton Old Signboard 25 Fried Hokkien Prawn Noodle
address: #01-25 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: Newton's Hokkien mee benchmark: a smoky, lard-laced tangle of bee hoon and yellow noodles simmered down in a generous prawn stock — singled out by Eatbook for its wok hei and reviewed by the Ordinary Patrons blog.

dish: Charcoal satay, BBQ prawns and otah (popiah discontinued 2023)
n: Bee Heng Satay, BBQ Prawn & Otah
address: #01-12 Newton Food Centre, 500 Clemenceau Avenue North, Singapore 229495
w: The family business behind Bee Heng Popiah (founded 1930, at Newton since 1977, now third-generation Gary Tan) — long Newton's resident popiah roll, written up by ieatishootipost and Miss Tam Chiak; since 2023 the stall has stopped the popiah and trades as Bee Heng Satay, BBQ Prawn & Otah.
